'''Famier Denzmorren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Denzmorren once ran a business enterprise called [[Bacta Bath and Beauty Works]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. However, after a batch of cheap [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] that he had sold turned out to be parasitic, he was forced to flee Naboo to evade the local authorities and angry women's-rights groups.

Later, on [[Genarius]], he became the part owner and barman of the [[Raging Rancor Cantina]], a [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]]-themed [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="Quarters">{{LivingForce|Blinking Eyes: Quarters}}</ref> The cantina burned down in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and Denzmorren began looking for a new business venture.<ref name="Peaces">{{LivingForce|Peaces}}</ref>
